purpose: Compact authority-first bootstrap for Dealix marketing/revenue specialists on current main. Prevents stale decks, historical pricing, Draft-PR authority and giant-repo prompt stuffing from becoming accidental truth.

load_order.reason: Brand V2 candidate for all rendered surfaces
evidence, brand, claim, UTM and outcome contract
cross-platform identity, bios and CTA posture
review-only evidence-backed event/founder starting assets; freshness recheck before event publication

hard_rules: Current main authority overrides all Draft PR and historical material.
Never use a Canva design as factual or commercial authority.
Never promote research or public contact data into a verified relationship.
Never promote social engagement or analytics into revenue, payment or customer proof.
Never use legacy fixed pilot prices, guarantees or retired sprint language in current public content.
Never bypass platform authorization, consent, suppression or specific approval gates.
WhatsApp business-number readiness may block WhatsApp only; Voice has an independent provider_and_number dependency; neither may globally block other owned-channel preparation.
Event facts in seed assets require freshness recheck before publication.
If evidence or authority is missing, output UNKNOWN, BLOCK or REVIEW rather than guess.
